Messages.Author: Chris.QJ
Messages.Body:
hi all,

Tegyrius becomes an Anarch by the cardless action. Now Tegyrius+ is
merged with him.

Is Tegyrius [[]
a) an Independent Anarch with a dormant Justicar title or
b) a Camarilla Justicar?

Same question for Go Anarch , Galarics Legacy, and a Seattle Comittee
counter.

(I think there might be a difference, because in the first case its a
"memory" effect, and in the three latter cases it is a "physical"
effect -> card or counter on the vampire)

Thanks.

Regards
Chris.QJ

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 22 Sep 2003 08:44:26 GMT, Chris.QJ <kut...@gmx.atNOSPAM>
scrawled:

>hi all,
>
>Tegyrius becomes an Anarch by the cardless action.

Thus becoming independant.

> Now Tegyrius+ is
>merged with him.
>
>Is Tegyrius [[]
>a) an Independent Anarch with a dormant Justicar title or
>b) a Camarilla Justicar?

c).
When you merge, the advanced version's text takes precedence.
Tegyrius^ is Camarilla.
Therefore, Tegyrius[[] becomes Camarilla.

All the anarch-becoming effects are undone if you change sects (in
this case, from independant to camarilla).
In the cardless case, he just ceases being anarch.

In the Galaric's case, Galaric's is burned. Same for Go-Anarch and
Seattle Committee counter.

>Same question for Go Anarch , Galarics Legacy, and a Seattle Comittee
>counter.
>
>(I think there might be a difference, because in the first case its a
>"memory" effect, and in the three latter cases it is a "physical"
>effect -> card or counter on the vampire)

They all die when Teg^ merges.

salem
